# 🚀 LeetCode Solutions

Welcome to my personal repository containing solutions to various algorithmic and data structure problems solved on [LeetCode](https://leetcode.com).

## 📂 Repository Structure

The solutions are automatically structured and pushed using a browser extension. Each problem folder contains:
*   **The Solution Code:** Written in my preferred programming language.
*   **A Problem-Specific README:** Automatically generated notes describing the problem description, difficulty rating, and runtime/memory efficiency metrics.

## 🛠️ Automated Sync

These solutions are automatically compiled and synced directly from the LeetCode platform using the **LeetPush** browser extension.

*Happy Coding!* 💻
